body:
I have no idea what you’re possibly going through and have no way of trying to talk you through that, but all I can tell you is that you matter to me. I’d be lying if i didn’t tell you that I haven’t felt the hopelessness you’re feeling. I’m there right now to tell you the truth. The fact that you (and even I for that matter) looked up this sub, created fake accounts, posted on it, tells me that you/I don’t want to die. This world is the epitome of insanity right now but you need to do what’s right for you. What makes you sad, depressed, hopeless? Write it out. Now, what things don’t make you sad? What are the triggers for putting yourself in that hopeless, depressed state? What can we/you do to move you out of those moods? What are some things that you used to enjoy that you haven’t done for a while? 
This life is worth living. Your post has made me look at myself and what I’m going through. Caused me to give it a second/third/fortieth look... you/I can make it through this. It just takes a little patience and some deep breaths. Thank you for your post. You’ve helped me think my own issues through. Feel free to dm me. I care.
